functions.name: IF
functions.description: Return true_value if condition is true, else false_value.

functions.name: STARTSWITH
functions.description: Check if text starts with prefix.

functions.name: ENDSWITH
functions.description: Check if text ends with suffix.

functions.name: DATEDIFF
functions.description: Difference between two dates in given unit.

functions.name: CAST
functions.description: Cast value to a different type.

functions.name: TRY_CAST
functions.description: Cast value, returning NULL on failure.

functions.name: REPLACE
functions.description: Replace occurrences of pattern in text with another value.

functions.name: IFNULL
functions.description: The value, or the fallback where the value is NULL (pandas fillna).

functions.name: GREATEST
functions.description: The largest of the arguments (any number of them).

functions.name: LEAST
functions.description: The smallest of the arguments (any number of them).

functions.name: SPLIT_PART
functions.description: The index-th piece (from 1) of text split by the separator.

functions.name: SUBSTR
functions.description: Part of the text from position start (from 1), optionally of a given length.

functions.name: LPAD
functions.description: Pad text on the left with fill up to length characters.

functions.name: RPAD
functions.description: Pad text on the right with fill up to length characters.

functions.name: REGEX_EXTRACT
functions.description: The part of the text matching a regular expression, or one of its groups (pandas str.extract).

functions.name: REGEX_MATCH
functions.description: True where the text contains a match of the regular expression.

functions.name: STRFTIME
functions.description: Format a date or timestamp as text, e.g. '%Y-%m' or '%d.%m.%Y'.

functions.name: STRPTIME
functions.description: Parse text into a timestamp with a format such as '%d.%m.%Y'.

functions.name: DAYOFWEEK
functions.description: Day of the week, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday.

functions.name: DATE_TRUNC
functions.description: Round a date down to the start of its 'year', 'quarter', 'month', 'week', 'day' or 'hour' (pandas dt.floor).

functions.name: SIGN
functions.description: -1, 0 or 1 by the sign of the value.

functions.name: DROP_DUPLICATES
functions.description: Remove duplicate rows based on column subset.

functions.name: DROP_NULL
functions.description: Drop rows where a column equals the null sentinel. With no sentinel, drops SQL NULLs. With a sentinel value, drops only rows whose column equals that value (real NULLs are kept).
